snippet.title: InterFishion - Twitch Integrated Game
snippet.description:
A chat‑driven fishing game for Twitch streamers where viewers compete for high scores. Ideal for stream breaks and keeping your community engaged.

Demo Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3044110/InterFishion/

Wishlist the game to get notified of full release and support the developers
